correctness.rationale: Three named tests are necessary f-nomid entries. Exhaustive exact rational recursion bounds every future shift using monotonicity and the least integer above each prefix ratio, traversing exactly 927939 prefixes and finding 1323 first-test candidates, eight after the other two tests; actual verify.py was run. Seven tuples have nonincreasing multiplicities and factor into binomid Pascal columns. The exceptional n^3(n+1)(n+3) has a uniform floor-carry proof for all moduli, with only E_4(1,1)=-1 compensated by E_2(1,1)=+1; Legendre valuations give integrality for all n,k. The exact modular lemma, finite endpoints and every quantifier were reconstructed; moduli 2..64 and rows through 80 were extra non-proving checks.

value.rationale: A natural infinite five-integer-parameter root-shift family receives a complete classification and a finite three-test recognition criterion. At degree five a non-Pascal-column exception first appears beyond the standard ordered-shift products, revealing a substantive local two-adic compensation phenomenon. The exceptional result is not a routine use of a lower-degree classification, arbitrary unmotivated finite slice, or code-only data point; it resolves a motivated subclass of the higher-degree polynomial binomid problem.
